purpose: Remove the boot-argument dependency from patch 0006, because the argument never reached the kernel and the mapping silently never ran

what_changed_and_why.symptom: The device printed vm/set_mmu_ttb_alternate#1 and never vm/set_mmu_ttb#1.
what_changed_and_why.previous_gate: 0006 mapped the segment only when PE_parse_boot_argn("tb-diag-segment") succeeded.

what_changed_and_why.fix: Look the segment up by name unconditionally. getsegdatafromheader returns NULL with size 0 for an absent name and the block requires both non-zero, so a kernel without the segment maps nothing.
